summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that the company and its wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired treasury shares under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 (the local equivalent of an issuer share buyback). On 10/06/2026, CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average price of AR$2,040.96 for AR$244,915,439, while Proener bought 30,000 ADRs (300,000 underlying shares) on NYSE at an average price of USD12.68 for USD380,627.57. Combined same-day purchases stayed below 25% of the prior ninety-business-day average daily trading volume. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date stated; routine buyback disclosure, so no deal terms apply.
